note: The intended skill set for every machine running this config. Only npx-installed skills are listed; the claude.ai-synced ones arrive on their own, and the routers travel in git. The SessionStart hook hooks/skills-drift.mjs compares this list against what is installed locally and reports the gap. Nothing installs automatically.

sources.install: npx skills add obra/superpowers -g -y --skill diagnosing-superpowers --skill dispatching-parallel-agents --skill executing-plans --skill finishing-a-development-branch --skill receiving-code-review --skill requesting-code-review --skill subagent-driven-development --skill systematic-debugging --skill test-driven-development --skill using-git-worktrees --skill using-superpowers --skill verification-before-completion --skill writing-plans --skill writing-skills
sources.note: Upstream shipped 15 skills as of 2026-10-22. superpowers-lab and grilling were dropped and are vendored under skills-vendored/; diagnosing-superpowers was added. brainstorming was dropped on 2026-10-31: the superpowers plugin carries a newer copy, so the install lists skills explicitly instead of '*'.
Upstream consolidated to a single skill in v2 on 2026-10-22. The four it used to ship are vendored under skills-vendored/.

sources.install: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -g -y --skill web-design-guidelines --skill vercel-react-best-practices --skill vercel-composition-patterns
npx skills add anthropics/skills -g -y --skill skill-creator --skill webapp-testing
sources.note: pdf, docx, xlsx and pptx were dropped on 2026-10-31: the claude.ai account delivers the same skills, equal or newer.

sources.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills -g -y --skill handoff --skill grill-me
npx skills add trailofbits/skills -g -y --skill codeql --skill semgrep --skill sarif-parsing

ignore.note: Present on at least one machine on purpose, but not wanted elsewhere. The drift hook stays quiet about these.

vendored.note: Skills whose upstream no longer ships them. They live in skills-vendored/ in this repository and reach each machine through git, not npx. Each machine symlinks ~/.claude/skills/<name> at ~/.claude/skills-vendored/<name>.
